reviewer: Claude review agent reviewer-desc, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of issue #88 description batch e: 38 missense variant-effect predictors and 49 batch records (38 metadata-correction claims, 11 sources). Store diff compared with origin/main; the 27 Chen 2020 descriptions checked row by row against Table 1; the others spot-checked against their abstracts; new-source licences checked against Europe PMC and arXiv. See docs/reviews/2026-10-11-description-batches-a-e.md.
limitations: Automated review by a separate Claude agent; not human scientific review.
Descriptions were checked against cited passages and abstracts; large groups were spot-checked rather than read row by row, except where stated in the scope.
Some Europe PMC responses no longer reproduce their pinned bytes; they are listed in changes.md and their hash_scope says these responses are not byte-stable.
